title: Process Redesign
lead: Structured analysis and redesign of business and IT processes to improve efficiency, quality and alignment with the target operating model.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: Process redesign involves mapping current (as-is) processes, identifying waste and inefficiencies, and designing improved (to-be) processes aligned with the target operating model. It draws on Lean, Six Sigma and BPM techniques and results in documented processes, RACI matrices and implementation plans.

sections.heading: ITOM Perspective
sections.body: The process dimension is central to the IT Operating Model. Process redesign translates the operating model principles into operational reality — defining how work flows, who does what, and how quality is ensured. It is a core activity in ITSM, outsourcing and agile transformation engagements.

items.desc: Documenting and understanding current processes, including pain points and waste.
Identifying the delta between current and desired process performance.
Designing the future process, including swimlanes, decision points and RACI.
Ownership, metrics and continuous improvement mechanisms for processes.
